articles.title: Swimming Champion Archie Goodburn to Deliver Rugby Match Ball in Front of 60,000 Fans
articles.summary: Champion swimmer Archie Goodburn, who returned to racing after brain tumour surgery, will deliver the match ball at Scotland's rugby game against Australia at Murrayfield on November 15.

articles.title: Fall Back! Daylight Saving Time Ends on November 1
articles.summary: Daylight Saving Time ends on November 1, 2026, when clocks go back an hour — a tradition with a surprisingly messy history.

articles.title: Halo's Next Chapter: A Famous Game Hero Changes Hands Again
articles.summary: Activision is taking over development of the Halo games from Halo Studios, and a writer argues the series needs fresh ideas more than another Master Chief remake.
